control_split: Per capture: first 64 hash-ranked TRAIN controls for input, next 64 for observation; remainder for optimizer
feature_scale: Original frozen 2000-gene panel and scales, including their original TRAIN-control feature construction

full_training_refit.sampler: Each epoch independently permutes the fixed optimizer row axis with TorchGenerator(seed=17+zero_based_epoch)
full_training_refit.scheduler: StepLR(step_size=45,gamma=0.9), advanced once per epoch for all three optimizers

primary_selection: Lowest mean standardized effect MSE on the fixed 11 heldout TRAIN combinations across the fixed 12 candidates
sampler: Each epoch independently permutes the fixed optimizer row axis with TorchGenerator(seed=17+zero_based_epoch)
scheduler: Installed CPATrainingPlan is unchanged. per_epoch adds only omitted scheduler.step calls; StepLR step_size remains 45 and gamma remains 0.9
scoring: Within condition: 2000-gene mean standardized squared effect error; then equal weight per condition
secondary: Same scores and prediction magnitudes on heldout cells of 44 seen combinations; no selection use
seen_validation: Per training combination and capture, first max(1,n//5) hash-ranked cells withheld; secondary diagnostic only
target: Population-average log1p response, equally averaged across the eight matched capture groups
tie_rule: Within 1e-12 of minimum: earlier checkpoint, reg_adv=1, then native scheduler
validation_scope: One fixed 11-combination fold from the original TRAIN panel, with 44 seen-combination cell holdouts used only as secondary checks.
